146554.overview: Cave Crawlers is an Action game, developed and published by Tomy Corporation, which was released in 1983.

146557.overview: Deep Six is an underwater shooter, in which one or two players (alternating) control a diver hunting for treasure. The diver is equipped with a harpoon gun with unlimited ammunition, but there are air reserves that will get depleted over time. The game is segmented into three screens, the goal of the first two is to clear them of the small fish, respectively jellyfish that swim around. Larger enemies also appear which can be shot for bonus points. On the third screen lies the treasure, guarded by giant octopi. These cannot be killed, but they can be stunned. After gaining the treasure, bonus points are awarded and the game begins again.

146571.overview: Mickey Athletic Land is a Sports game, developed and published by Tomy Corporation, which was released in Japan in 1983.

146572.overview:
Mission Attack is a 3D science-fiction themed shoot-em-up. Your goal is to attack and destroy the enemy's tower after passing through four waves of opponents. Each wave takes place in a different geometric landscape, with enemy craft arriving from the distance, and trying to collide with you. You can move backwards and forwards along the bottom of the screen to target or avoid the enemy. Every time you move, your energy depletes but shooting the orange enemies replenishes your fuel.

The game's four zones are the black zone, the blue zone, the space base zone and the mother tower zone. The main difference between these is the background graphics. The blue zone is slightly different in that you head towards distant mountains along a narrow path and straying from the path uses a lot of energy. Enemy bikers may suddenly appear in the last three zones, but are missing from the first. The last zone ends when you reach and destroy the tower, after which you then start from the beginning at a higher level of difficulty.

146573.overview: Monster Inn is a platform game similar to Space Panic, except with monsters instead of aliens.  It was developed and published by Tomy Corporation, which was released in Japan in 1983.

146574.overview: You need strategy and fast moves to help MR. DO! harvest the fruit from his orchards and avoid getting caught by the evil Badguys or Alphamonster! Throw your Power Ball to knock them out, or drop apples on them. Pick all the cherries or eliminate the Badguys and you can go on to the next orchard, where the Badguys are faster and meaner!

146575.overview:
Mystery Gold is a 2D fixed screen digging game, similar to Dig Dug and Mr. Do! . You play as a miner looking for buried gold. There are five treasure boxes, two of which contain deadly ghosts. There are also some green monsters that can wander the tunnels that you leave behind as you explore the area. One of the monsters (flashing white) may also have the ability to dig their own tunnels. Your goal on each level is to collect all of the gold and then defeat the green monsters.

Monsters and ghosts can be dispatched with three blasts of the miner's light. If you have not collected all of the gold, monsters will respawn. Also, the monster is only stunned if you hit it from far away. Digging next to water veins will cause a flood in nearby tunnels that can be used to drown monsters and ghosts. If you are not careful, it can also kill you. The game is over when all lives are lost.

458947.overview:
Tommy Mickey Mouse's Jungle Adventure Released around 1982, Made in Japan If I just say that it's a movie, you probably won't understand what it's about, so I don't need to say anything here, but for those who have looked online but can't find any information, I'll write in detail. I didn't find anything when I looked, so if you think you can understand it just by looking, you don't need to read any further. If you don't know anything, I think you'll enjoy it much more if you read it before watching it. However, even though I tried to write it as briefly as possible, the content is complicated, so it's a fairly long text.

In terms of the story, Donald attacks Mickey and Minnie while they're driving, and at the start, as they pass a bridge, the car is torn to pieces, and Minnie and two tires fall into the river. The objective of the game is to rescue Minnie and Tire, and the route goes from left to right, then right to left again, and you have to hang from the dangling hand of Goofy, the only one who is trying to help you, and move to a vine-like place on the side. However, if you hang on to the hand at the wrong time, such as when flames come just before, you will immediately miss. However, if you hesitate even a little, you will be forced to go out, so be careful. Here, you can move three-dimensionally, but flames come one after another, so this place is quite difficult, and you have to move while predicting where the flames will move and avoiding them. I guess I'll have to remember where the next flame will come by making mistakes many times. You can use the drinks provided to get rid of them, but it's better to get a hamburger and move forward as quickly as possible.

When you get the hamburger, Donald in the bottom right will disappear for a certain amount of time, so go down to the pier during that time, and when Donald appears from the river, use the action key to hit him with a punch. If you hit him twice, he will disappear. This will be the only safe area, but there's no point in staying there forever, so move to the left. From here, you will have a second confrontation with Donald who has retreated. You want to hit him with a punch in the same way, but a fierce fish will fly out of the water, so you have to jump or back to the starting position to avoid it. If you hit the flame above your head when you jump, it will be a mistake, and if you approach after Donald has completely left, it will be a mistake. After that, after the third confrontation, you can finally go to the place where the crocodile is, but the situation here is also quite complicated. Moreover, a fierce fish periodically jumps out of the water,

and a crocodile pops its head out of the river, but if you try to get on its head it's a mistake. You can only ride the crocodile when it opens its mouth wide, so while riding the crocodile, you throw the rope, rescue Minnie or Tire, and return to the car.
